ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Parent Double Extension File Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect execution of suspicious double extension files in ParentCommandLine

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.doc\\\.lnk$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.docx\\\.lnk$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.xls\\\.lnk$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.xlsx\\\.lnk$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.ppt\\\.lnk$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.pptx\\\.lnk$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.rtf\\\.lnk$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.pdf\\\.lnk$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.txt\\\.lnk$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.doc\\\.js$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.docx\\\.js$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.xls\\\.js$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.xlsx\\\.js$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.ppt\\\.js$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.pptx\\\.js$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.rtf\\\.js$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.pdf\\\.js$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\.txt\\\.js$")) OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.doc\\\.lnk.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.docx\\\.lnk.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.xls\\\.lnk.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.xlsx\\\.lnk.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ppt\\\.lnk.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pptx\\\.lnk.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.rtf\\\.lnk.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pdf\\\.lnk.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.txt\\\.lnk.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.doc\\\.js.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.docx\\\.js.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.xls\\\.js.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.xlsx\\\.js.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ppt\\\.js.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pptx\\\.js.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.rtf\\\.js.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pdf\\\.js.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.txt\\\.js.*")))
